floors.name: Ground Level
floors.summary: Atrium floor of the 2016 wing (lounge, giant UF letters, Swamp Boss gator-head statue, free library) with the corridor running west to the hotel reception; Game Room (14 bowling lanes, 9 billiards + 1 snooker, table tennis, foosball, air hockey, arcade) under the food court; Gator Esports Center; Orange & Brew (now Cabo Mexican Grill per the wayfinding POI) behind the curved SE facade; Senate Chamber and meeting rooms G310-G330 in the 2016 wing; Subway, The Market, SG Bike Repair, barbershop; Career Connections Center lower floor; the open breezeway under the Grand Ballroom wing; South Terrace vestibule to the amphitheater.

zones.name: Chamber
zones.notes: Curved tiers of grey laminate desks with navy high-back chairs; cherry wood wall with chevron reveals behind the dais; US and Florida flags; cream walls; curved glass/drywall front toward the corridor (curved wall on the printed map).

zones.name: Gator Esports Center
zones.notes: Long narrow room: wood-look floor, dark ceiling, black gaming desks with blue edge LEDs, white hex neon panels on dark hex-textured walls, lit GATOR ESPORTS CENTER channel letters, glass streaming booths, red-orange bench along one wall.

zones.name: Game Room
zones.notes: Grey wood-look plank floor (lanes area) and blue/orange patterned carpet (billiards); maple-look lanes with Brunswick ball returns; white round columns between lane pairs; black overhead truss with monitors over the approaches; navy curved booth seating and black tables behind the approaches; video wall/banner strip above the pins with a gator mural on the masking units; ceiling fans; dark navy walls with the GAME ROOM / The University of Florida space-themed wall graphic; blue-felt pool tables with square LED light frames.

zones.name: Hotel Reception
zones.swamphacks_xii: overnight entrance (Reitz Hotel ground floor, near Subway)

zones.name: Atrium floor (lounge) under the Level 1 void
zones.notes: Footprint of the Level 1 atrium void projected down (the MVF Ground corridor polygon covers this floor area). White terrazzo floor with a blue patterned carpet inset under the lounge; navy gator footprints inlaid along a winding metal strip; white curved balcony fascias with LED coves, vertical-picket metal railings (gator-shaped cut-outs reported on all three balcony levels); cedar-tone wood-slat ceilings with dark curved ribs (patterned on a gator's underbelly, per the Alligator); scissor stairs crossing the void; giant orange UF letters on a gator-skin patterned wall; Swamp Boss gator-head statue.
